posts.author: Drachenzorn32
posts.body:
Hello there. I have a Problem. I´m playing RPG Maker VX Ace.
Since yesterday, when I test the game, I can only scroll down in the menu, not up. Every now and then it automatically scrolls through, as if I had stick drift only without a controller ^^. In the game itself, I can turn left and right. As soon as I release the arrow key, the character turns up and automatically walks up.
Please can someone help me?

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: Either you have a key that got stuck and needs to be cleaned or you have both a keyboard and a gamepad connected at the same time. Disconnect the gamepad and reconnect it. The problem should be gone by then.

posts.author: Drewster237
posts.body: For VXA, it's usually a gamepad problem I've discovered. Try unplugging any connected controllers.

posts.author: Drachenzorn32
posts.body: it was really the controller. Thank you very much.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
There have been multiple causes for this effect, from crumbs nside the keyboard to connected gamepads and graphic tablets to the use of old and outdated Win95-drivers.
the last part happens if you install the drivers given with graphic tablets - those are Ein95/98 drivers and not needed on modern Windows versions, but installing them messes up the old API that is also used by VXA. Just deinstall them, windows will detect your tablet automatically.
